text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright! Today we're introducing a tour of
super-popular 'Insta-worthy spots' among the youth!
A course perfect for a weekend outing...”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... How wonderful!
I really admire things like that, yes I do...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't have the courage just yet, but...
I'd love to go there myself someday...
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to come with me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
B-But... ain't it too early for me to...!
choice_data_list: If you don't try, you'll never take that first step!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaah, I really came here, didn't I...!
Is it really okay for someone like me to be here...!
choice_data_list: Now that we're here, let's make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Yes!
My heart's pounding, but I want to enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually! There's a place I've really wanted to check out!
It's a store with affordable cosmetics, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, but do you reckon it's too high a hurdle to go buy makeup without a friend's advice...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Cafe has a place she wants to try goin' to as well.
Wonder if it'll be fine over there...?
Hmm-mm~~...?!
choice_data_list: First, let's calm down at a café.
No, let's take the plunge and start with cosmetics!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-And so!
Let's eat some sweets and have our strategy meeting!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawawa! Everywhere I look is so cute~! Never seen nothin' like this, looks delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And the menu is on a "tablet"!
It's so colorful and bleep-bloopy and cute~...!
choice_data_list: Do you know how to ask?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, it won't press...? 
Whoa!? Now it disappeared completely...!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
You can also order verbally~!
Whenever you're ready, I'll take your order♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Well then, um, um...
I'll take... Option B from this "Dreamy Cute Set"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
For the drink... um, this one!
The "Royal Honey Marshmallow Milk Tea"!
choice_data_list: Looks like you can choose hot or iced!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! H-Hot, please!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪
And what can I get for you over there—?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Alright! I ordered properly, han...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like they have takeout sweets too.
"Nationwide frozen shipping available!" huh...
Mmm...
choice_data_list: You want to send it home? Let's ask them!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gyah! How did you know!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this must be that
big-city "smoothness" folks talk about!
Ya never cease to amaze me, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And after that, we had fun exploring
every corner of the trendy district until sundown...”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Jumping straight to cosmetics~!?
Shouldn't we take this one step at a time...!
choice_data_list: With things like this, being decisive is key!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I clear the big obstacle first,
maybe I'll be fine going anywhere else after that...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ayaaa~~~, it's dazzling...!
Everythin' is so cute, and smells so nice...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh, Curren-san said before,
"For starters, check the tester♪"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
First, this lipstick... wait, why's it beige?
Huh? What on earth is a "con-sea-ler"...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
???
"Lip tint"? "Comes with a spatula"...?
W-What's the difference between essence and serum...?!'

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I don't know what anything is...!
All I know is that it's super cute~!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's fine if you don't understand...?
Maybe it's okay not to know...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I told them that while I wasn't an expert myself, nowadays you could easily figure out how to use it just by looking it up online.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I see! That was an option all along~! Then it'll be totally fine if we look into it later!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Nah~, that never crossed my mind...!
Back home, I mostly found out about trendy things
from magazines or the TV..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm just gonna go with my gut
and buy whichever one I find cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And after that, we had fun exploring
every corner of the trendy district until sundown...”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~♪ Today was truly so much fun!
I'm so glad I took the leap and went...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's all thanks to you
taking me out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "So, um...! Uh, this is out of nowhere, but, p-please take this...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Actually... I bought this while you were in the restroom, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"On TV earlier, they were saying
'Give a smart parting gift when saying goodbye' too..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-this might not be much of a thank-you gift, but...
It might even be a little too fancy for me...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"‘If you never try, you'll never move forward.’
So that's why! I really wanted to tell you how grateful I am!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... Likewise.
*Ahem*...! Well then, once again...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Thank ya so very much for today!
Thanks to you, one of my dreams came true."
